registry.emptyBody: The apps you register will appear here: installed programs, web addresses and protocols.
registry.addHint: Add an app without a category

form.healthHint: A request without credentials at most once a minute, only while the window is in view.
form.iconHint: PNG up to 256 KB and 1024 pixels per side. It changes right away, no need to save. Without an image, an executable shows its own icon and other apps show their initials.

confirm.deleteAppBody: The app leaves the registry. The program or website is not touched.
confirm.deleteCategoryBody: The apps in this category stay in the registry, without a category.
confirm.changedBody: The program is no longer the one you confirmed last time. If you updated it yourself, launch it and confirm the new version.
confirm.deleteGroupBody: The apps stay in the registry: only the group is deleted.

lock.bodyHello: Unlock with Windows Hello or with your PIN.
lock.retryIn_one: Too many attempts. Try again in {{count}} second.
lock.retryIn_other: Too many attempts. Try again in {{count}} seconds.
lock.enterHint: Type your PIN and press Enter.

security.title: Security
security.offBody: Set a PIN: the app will lock every time it starts, after a period of inactivity and when you lock Windows.
security.onBody: The app locks every time it starts, after the chosen period of inactivity and when you lock Windows. Ctrl+L locks it right away. The lock stops people using this computer, not programs already running.
security.helloHint: Your PIN always remains available as an alternative.
security.helloPrompt: Confirm your identity to use Windows Hello with {{name}}.

pin.disableBody: Enter your current PIN. Windows Hello is turned off together with the lock; the registry stays as it is.
pin.hint: 6 to 16 digits. All-identical digits and sequences such as 123456 are not allowed.
pin.mismatch: The two new PINs do not match.

secrets.title: Secrets of {{name}}
secrets.intro: Values are kept in the Windows Credential Manager and are never shown here: they are copied to the clipboard, outside Windows clipboard history, and the clipboard clears itself shortly after.
secrets.valueHint: Once saved, the value is no longer visible: you can copy it or replace it.
secrets.copied_one: “{{label}}” copied: the clipboard clears in {{count}} second.
secrets.copied_other: “{{label}}” copied: the clipboard clears in {{count}} seconds.
secrets.deleteBody: The value is also deleted from the Windows Credential Manager. This cannot be undone.

settings.title: Settings
settings.shortcutBody: The shortcut opens the palette from any app: search, choose with the arrow keys and press Enter. While locked it brings up the lock screen.
settings.shortcutInactive: Not active: another app already uses it. Choose a different one.
settings.autostartLabel: Start {{name}} when you sign in to Windows
settings.autostartHint: It starts in the tray, without a window: the palette shortcut is ready right away.
settings.accentHint: {{accent}}: used for focus, selection and switches. The logo stays verdigris.

palette.label: Command palette
palette.placeholder: Search for an app, a secret or an action
palette.changed: The executable has changed: launch it from the main window to confirm.
palette.hint: ↑ ↓ to choose · Enter to run · Esc to close

groups.title: Launch groups
groups.noApps: No apps yet: add one from the list below.
groups.resultChanged: These executables changed since they were last confirmed: check them and launch them one by one.
groups.addHint: Collect the apps you open together and launch them in one go.

errors.DB_WRONG_KEY: The key does not open the database, or the file is damaged.
errors.DB_CIPHER_UNAVAILABLE: Database encryption is not active: the registry is not opened.
errors.DB_SCHEMA_TOO_NEW: The registry was created by a newer version of the app.
errors.DB_KEY_MISSING: The registry exists, but its key is not in the Credential Manager. Your data has not been touched.
errors.DB_KEY_INVALID: The stored registry key is not valid.
errors.NAME_INVALID: The name must be 1 to 80 characters long, without control characters.
errors.NAME_DUPLICATE: An item with this name already exists.
errors.URL_INVALID: The address is not valid. Do not put a user name or password in the address.
errors.SCHEME_NOT_ALLOWED: This type of address is not allowed.
errors.EXECUTABLE_MISSING: The program is no longer at the registered path.
errors.HASH_MISMATCH: The program has changed since it was last confirmed.
errors.TAG_INVALID: Each tag can be up to 32 characters, with at most 12 tags.
errors.PIN_INVALID: The PIN must have 6 to 16 digits, with no letters or spaces.
errors.PIN_TOO_SIMPLE: The PIN is too easy to guess: avoid all-identical digits and sequences such as 123456.
errors.PIN_NOT_SET: The lock is not set up: set a PIN first.
errors.PIN_THROTTLED: Too many attempts: wait before trying again.
errors.PIN_HASH_FAILED: The PIN could not be checked. Try again; if it happens again, restart the app.
errors.IDLE_INVALID: The inactivity time must be between 1 and 240 minutes.
errors.SECRET_LABEL_INVALID: The label must have 1 to 60 characters, with no line breaks.
errors.SECRET_LABEL_DUPLICATE: This app already has a secret with this label.
errors.SECRET_USERNAME_INVALID: The username can have at most 200 characters, with no line breaks or tabs.
errors.SECRET_VALUE_INVALID: The value cannot be empty or contain the NUL character.
errors.SECRET_TOO_LONG: The value exceeds the 2560 bytes the Windows Credential Manager accepts.
errors.KEYSTORE_UNAVAILABLE: The Windows Credential Manager is not responding.
errors.APP_DATA_UNAVAILABLE: The app data folder is not accessible.
errors.DIALOG_FAILED: The file picker did not open.
errors.LAUNCH_FAILED: Windows did not launch the app.
errors.LOCKED: The app is locked. Unlock it to continue.
errors.NOT_FOREGROUND: Bring the window to the front and try again.
errors.HELLO_NOT_ENABLED: Windows Hello is not turned on for this app. Use your PIN.
errors.HELLO_NO_DEVICE: No Windows Hello device is available on this computer.
errors.HELLO_NOT_CONFIGURED: Windows Hello is not set up for your account. Set it up in Windows Settings.
errors.HELLO_DISABLED_BY_POLICY: Windows Hello is turned off by this computer's policies.
errors.HELLO_BUSY: The Windows Hello device is busy. Try again shortly.
errors.HELLO_RETRIES_EXHAUSTED: Too many Windows Hello attempts. Use your PIN.
errors.HELLO_FAILED: Windows Hello did not respond. Use your PIN.
errors.SECRET_MISSING: The value of this secret is no longer in the Credential Manager. Replace it to use it again.
errors.CLIPBOARD_UNAVAILABLE: The clipboard is busy with another app. Try again in a moment.
errors.SHORTCUT_INVALID: Shortcut not allowed: choose one from the list.
errors.SHORTCUT_TAKEN: Shortcut not available: another app already uses it. Choose a different one.
errors.TRAY_UNAVAILABLE: The notification area icon is not available.
errors.HEALTH_CHECK_WEB_ONLY: Status checks only apply to web apps.
errors.GROUP_TOO_LARGE: A group can hold at most 20 apps.
errors.GROUP_APP_DUPLICATE: The same app appears twice in the group.
errors.AUTOSTART_UNAVAILABLE: Windows did not allow changing the sign-in startup.
errors.ICON_INVALID: The image is not a valid PNG.
errors.ICON_TOO_LARGE: The image exceeds 256 KB or 1024 pixels per side.

legal.termsSummary: {{name}} is provided as is, for personal use: your data and its copies are your responsibility.
legal.privacySummary: {{name}} has no server and sends no data: everything stays on this computer.

use.title: Use
use.body: {{name}} is a personal tool to catalogue, protect and launch your apps from one place. It does not replace a corporate identity manager or a federated sign-in system.

warranty.title: No warranty
warranty.body: {{name}} is provided as is, without warranties of any kind, to the extent permitted by law. Its developer is not liable for damages arising from its use.

data.title: Your data
data.body: The registry and secrets stay on this computer and are your responsibility. If you forget the PIN, the registry currently cannot be unlocked: keep a copy of the registry file.

apps.title: The apps you launch
apps.body: {{name}} launches the programs and sites you choose. It checks that an executable has not changed since your last confirmation, but does not guarantee that it is safe.

security.title: Security
security.body: The lock stops people using this computer, not programs already running in the session. Protect your Windows sign-in as you would anyway.

changes.title: Changes
changes.body: These terms may change with new versions of {{name}}: the version shown in the app you use applies.

collected.title: What data
collected.body: The apps you register (names, paths, addresses, categories, groups and icons), the lock settings, of which only the PIN fingerprint and its length are kept, and the secrets you save.

where.title: Where it stays
where.body: In a database encrypted with SQLCipher, in the app's data folder under %LOCALAPPDATA%. The database key and the secrets are kept in Windows Credential Manager, on this computer only. Appearance preferences are kept in the app's profile.

outgoing.title: What leaves this computer
outgoing.body: Nothing, except what you ask for: the apps and sites you launch are opened and, if you turn on the health check for a web app, a request is sent to that address at most once a minute, with no credentials or cookies. No telemetry, no statistics, no update checks.

hello.title: Windows Hello
hello.body: Windows performs the check: {{name}} only receives the result, never biometric data.

clipboard.title: Clipboard
clipboard.body: A copied secret is kept out of the Windows clipboard history and sync, and is cleared after 30 seconds, on lock and on exit.

erase.title: Erasing your data
erase.body: Delete apps and secrets in the app, then uninstall {{name}} and delete its folder in %LOCALAPPDATA%. The database key stays in Windows Credential Manager until you remove it there.

developer.title: Who develops the app
developer.body: {{name}} is developed by {{author}}, who receives no data: there is nothing held by the developer to access or erase.

about.tagline: The portal for your apps: it catalogues, protects and launches them from one place, local and web.
about.etymology: From the Greek πύλη, gate, and τάξις, order: the ordering of gates.
about.dataValue: Encrypted and only on this computer: no server, no telemetry
